properties.name: security.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC secret used to sign JWTs.

properties.name: security.jwt.issuer
properties.description: JWT issuer claim (should be a valid URL string).

properties.name: security.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins. Empty = no cross-origin access.

properties.name: security.cors.max-age
properties.description: Max age in seconds for CORS preflight cache.
